name: trade-ngin
$comment: builtin-baseline pins the vcpkg registry commit so every machine and CI
runner resolves the same dependency versions.
Lower bound: must stay at or after the 2026-03-23 commit that introduced
libpqxx 8. src/data/postgres_database.cpp uses the pqxx 8 API
(exec(query, params), result::one_row), which does not exist in 7.x.
Upper bound: must stay before the 2026-05-23 commit that moved arrow to
24.0.0. Arrow 24's bpacking_simd_kernel_internal.h does not compile with
This pin is arrow 23.0.1 + libpqxx 8.0.1. Bump deliberately, and rebuild
arrow on Windows before merging any bump.
